title: itaca.yml v2
description: Per-repo hot state. Hot state only: no narrative log (see journal/), no decision records (see docs/decisions/). Hard cap ~60 lines.

state.description: The whole hot state. A fresh session reads this and nothing else.

goal.description: One line: the outcome currently pursued

doing.description: Work items in flight, each with its PR reference

done.description: Last ~5 completed items, pruned aggressively. Not a changelog.

blockers.description: Hard blockers only: things that make the next action impossible

next_safe_action.description: One line: the single next action that is safe to take without asking

assumptions.description: Unverified assumptions that would invalidate work in flight if false

decisions.description: Pointer to the ADR directory; decisions never live in this file

updated.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the state was last touched
